hooks.command: input=$(cat); path=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$path" in */src/procedural/*|src/procedural/*) if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // ""' | grep -q 'Math\.random'; then echo 'Blocked: Math.random() is banned in src/procedural/ — use mulberry32(seed) from src/procedural/prng.ts (determinism contract, CLAUDE.md).' >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0

input=$(cat); path=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); body=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // ""'); case "$path" in *.dev.vars) exit 0;; esac; if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -q 'sk-ant-'; then echo 'Blocked: literal Anthropic key material (sk-ant-...) must never be written into the repo — keys live only in worker/.dev.vars (gitignored).' >&2; exit 2; fi; case "$path" in */Lokilibrary/src/*|src/*) if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Eq 'ANTHROPIC_API_KEY|STEAM_WEB_API_KEY|PIXELLAB_API_KEY|ELEVENLABS_API_KEY|TWITCH_CLIENT'; then echo 'Blocked: API-key references are banned in src/ (the frontend bundle ships publicly). All AI/Steam calls go through the Worker; keys live in worker/.dev.vars (CLAUDE.md).' >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0
